div.head: II Cn 56
div.ab: Gif open morð weorðe, þæt man sy amyrred, agyfe man þam magum.
Gif open morð weorðe, þæt man sy amyrdred, agife man þara magum.
Qui murdrum aperte perpetrabit, reddatur parentibus interfecti.
Open morð. Gif open morð weorðe ðæt man amyrred sy, agyue man magum [þone banan].
Gif open morð weorðe þæt man sy amyrðred, agyfe man þam magum þone banan.
Wenn ein unleugbarer heimlicher Mord geschieht, so dass ein Mensch vernichtet (ermordet A) ist, so liefere man an die Verwandten [des Getödteten] (den Mörder B) aus.
If an undeniable secret murder happens, so that a person is destroyed (murdered, A), let [the killer] (the murderer, B) be handed over to the kinsmen [of the slain].
Murder which is discovered. If anyone dies by violence and it becomes evident that it is a case of murder, the murderer shall be given up to the kinsmen [of the slain man].
If manifest murder occur, so that a man is destroyed, [the murderer] is to be given up to the kinsmen.
If it comes to be shown that someone who has died violently has been murdered, the murderer shall be surrendered to the family of the victim.
div.note: Murder to the Anglo-Saxons meant killing by secret means.
þone banan: omitted GA, added in B in a sixteenth-century hand
